## Purpose
Attaching files to a chat message (images, audio, PDF and Office documents, text) in the playground and agent chat. The chips show how each file will reach the chosen model: "as image", "as audio", "as document", or "as text" when it is converted first.

## Responsibilities
- `useInputSupport()` reads `inputSupportApi.get` (GET `/api/uploads/support`). `KIND_META`.
- `AttachmentButton` is a file picker. Limits: at most `MAX_FILES` (5) per message ("At most 5 files per message.") and `MAX_MB` per file ("<name> exceeds the N MB limit.").
- `AttachmentChipView` (with `how` / `explain`) and `PendingAttachments`.

## Key elements
The exports listed.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond component state.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- The backend rules live in `app/services/attachments.py`. Used by the playground and the agent chat.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **An image for a model that cannot see becomes its OCR text;** audio the API cannot take becomes its transcript.

## How to rebuild this file
Implement as described; copying the file is the reliable route for exact styling.
